rows.speaker: Hugi
rows.en: Come then, you foolish humans...
rows.display_text: 「Come then, you foolish humans...」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Ho ho ho ho ho! Impossible, impossible! No one could stand against a force this size!
rows.display_text:
「Ho ho ho ho ho! Impossible, impossible!
No one could stand against a force this
size!」

rows.speaker: Gagarn
rows.en: Then let us turn your fear into despair next -- by burning the Earth to ashes.
rows.display_text:
「Then let us turn your fear into despair
next -- by burning the Earth to ashes.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: All forces, forward! If anyone stands in our way, remove them by force!
rows.display_text:
「All forces, forward! If anyone stands in
our way, remove them by force!」

rows.speaker: King Vega
rows.en: You Earthlings! I'll settle the score for years of grudges, right here and now!
rows.display_text:
「You Earthlings! I'll settle the score for
years of grudges, right here and now!」

rows.speaker: Moroha
rows.en: Whatever the situation, my heart still races before a fight...!
rows.display_text:
「Whatever the situation, my heart still
races before a fight...!」

rows.speaker: Toma
rows.en: And it seems our opponents have arrived.
rows.display_text:
「And it seems our opponents have
arrived.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: That's as far as you go, Alien Alliance! And you too, Shadow Angels!
rows.display_text:
「That's as far as you go, Alien Alliance!
And you too, Shadow Angels!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Now that we're here, we won't let you take one more step forward!
rows.display_text:
「Now that we're here, we won't let you
take one more step forward!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: I won't let you have your way with the Earth!
rows.display_text:
「I won't let you have your way with the
Earth!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Good timing! I'll clean you all up in one go, right here!
rows.display_text:
「Good timing! I'll clean you all up in one
go, right here!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Attention all units. We've been given nine minutes. We annihilate the enemy force within that time.
rows.display_text:
「Attention all units. We've been given
nine minutes. We annihilate the enemy
force within that time.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I'll protect it... the Earth... everyone's future.
rows.display_text:
「I'll protect it... the Earth... everyone's
future.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Let's go, everyone! This is the big gamble with the Earth on the line!!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, everyone! This is the big
gamble with the Earth on the line!!」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: Enemy force confirmed annihilated! This is our victory!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy force confirmed annihilated! This
is our victory!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Phew... I wondered how it would turn out, but somehow we made it.
rows.display_text:
「Phew... I wondered how it would turn
out, but somehow we made it.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Everyone's feelings and strength are what brought us today's victory.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone's feelings and strength are
what brought us today's victory.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: But the fight isn't over yet. I'll be praying for everyone's continued efforts.
rows.display_text:
「But the fight isn't over yet. I'll be
praying for everyone's continued efforts.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Captain Waltfeld! At this rate, our losses will push past the limit!
rows.display_text:
「Captain Waltfeld! At this rate, our
losses will push past the limit!」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Tch...! If we can't settle this in the next minute, we'll have no choice but to fall back...!
rows.display_text:
「Tch...! If we can't settle this in the
next minute, we'll have no choice but to
fall back...!」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Everyone, rally your spirits! Stake everything on this one minute!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, rally your spirits! Stake
everything on this one minute!」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: The 9-minute operation time has passed!
rows.display_text: 「The 9-minute operation time has passed!」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: N-no good! If we keep fighting like this, we can't win!!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good! If we keep fighting like
this, we can't win!!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: E-even if you say that! What are we supposed to do!?
rows.display_text:
「E-even if you say that! What are we
supposed to do!?」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: The operation's a failure! All units, retreat!!
rows.display_text:
「The operation's a failure! All units,
retreat!!」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: What's the status of Goma's movements?
rows.display_text: 「What's the status of Goma's movements?」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: It's accelerating as it approaches Earth. It'll enter the combat area in one more hour.
rows.display_text:
「It's accelerating as it approaches
Earth. It'll enter the combat area in one
more hour.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: Also, the Alien Alliance and the Shadow Angels are deployed in the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「Also, the Alien Alliance and the Shadow
Angels are deployed in the surrounding
area.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: Who would've thought a mixed force like that would form, of all times.
rows.display_text:
「Who would've thought a mixed force like
that would form, of all times.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: We mustn't give up. We have a mission to fight, carrying humanity's tomorrow on our backs.
rows.display_text:
「We mustn't give up. We have a mission
to fight, carrying humanity's tomorrow on
our backs.」

rows.speaker: Waltfeld
rows.en: I know. Once we've come this far, all that's left is to throw everything we have at it.
rows.display_text:
「I know. Once we've come this far, all
that's left is to throw everything we
have at it.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: Then, issue the sortie order to all forces. Let's give it our all, without giving up hope until the very last moment.
rows.display_text:
「Then, issue the sortie order to all
forces. Let's give it our all, without
giving up hope until the very last moment.」
